method: Unofficial fan-poll log. Scraped weekly by src/scrape_polls.py as a run_weekly.py stage, plus hand-logged rows (FB groups, transcribed result images — marked auto_scraped:false). Sources are self-selected fan-war polls (e.g. bbnaijadaily.com widget allows up to 100 votes/person), so numbers measure vote-war intensity, not electorate share. Under the poll-matrix engine (2026-09-22) polls ARE the likelihood, not a prior anchor: full-share sources (live widget + manual rows) become matrix observations with weight w = grade · min(n, cap) · λ^Δt, renormalised per row, then aggregated. Rank-only sources (ngnews247 video titles) contribute ORDERING constraints only — never shares. The poll-anchored-prior mechanism of the retired MCMC engine (alpha-column location shift) is gone; docs/predictions.json polls.anchor_applied is false on every poll-matrix run. All snapshots are archived per week under data/raw/week_XX/.

concordance_definitions.rank_concordance: Share of housemate pairs where the poll's save-% rank order agrees with the model's safety order (poll engine: higher share = safer; retired MCMC: lower Cox relative hazard = safer). Computed by src/score_week.py; 0.5 = coin flip.
concordance_definitions.winner_top3: Poll leader set vs the model's p_rank_1 top-3. Known structural gap: blog coverage (the retired blog-CPI term) ≠ vote intensity — quiet fanbases (Keivo, Ricky) poll high while high-coverage housemates (Chimsom Chuka) can poll low with anti-vote drag.
